content.text: {"actions":[],"missing":["Observed account profiles (region, sector) for all queried accounts","Observed current consent for all queried accounts","Observed signal records for all queried accounts","Observed account.initiative, initiative.need and need.offering links for all queried accounts","Observed offering.proof links and approved proof.verified=true for the relevant proofs","Approved offering assurance values (needed for assurance_pack)","Approved proof shareable values (needed for reference_intro)"],"reasoning_summary":"The approved seller policy (ee1497841342bca) allows all actions in regions FR, DE and US and blocks the restricted sector.
